name: WhiteFiber Inc. Ordinary Shares
summary: WhiteFiber, Inc. specializes in delivering foundational infrastructure solutions for artificial intelligence. It achieves this by developing and operating high-performance data centers and cloud platforms, all specifically optimized for graphical processing units (GPUs). The company's service offerings include colocation facilities, managed hosting solutions, and GPU-as-a-Service (GaaS), which collectively cater to the demanding computational, storage, and networking needs of AI and machine learning applications. WhiteFiber operates on an end-to-end vertically integrated model. The firm emerged as a spin-off from Bit Digital, Inc., and is scheduled for an initial public offering (IPO) in August 2025. Its corporate headquarters are located within the United States.
